title: SDK + API launch: function-calling, structured outputs, streaming — cross-team playbook & sample inventory
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Coordinate a production-ready launch for the consolidated SDK + API surface that ships three capabilities together: function-calling (stable contract for tool integrations), structured JSON/typed outputs (schema-first guidance and validation), and streaming responses across SDKs (Python, JS, Go).

Scope in: SDK bindings and canonical samples for Python/JS/Go; unified API docs; release notes and migration guidance; staged rollout with telemetry; compatibility test matrix.
Scope out: New model architecture changes (model release handled by model-onboarding), large-scale migration automation (separate migration program).

Success metrics: documentation coverage >=100% of canonical endpoints; sample-run pass rate >= 95% in staging; zero critical regression bugs in first 72h; adoption signal: 10+ internal Redwood apps adopt structured output patterns in first month.

Primary stakeholders: PM (Aisha Patel), Eng leads (Daniel Ortiz, Noor Singh), SDK owners (Luca Moretti - python, Mei Tan - js, Harish Rao - go), Docs (Priya Nair), Design (Mina Cho), DevRel (Tom Becker), QA (Ruth Kim).
checklist: Draft release notes (first pass) and get PM/Eng/Docs sign-off
Create canonical sample matrix (Python/JS/Go) for function-calls + structured outputs + streaming
Implement SDK examples and publish release candidates to internal package registry
Add API docs: parameter contract, example payloads, streaming contract, and migration notes
Run compatibility and E2E tests against staging runtime-1.20 and quantized variants
Set up monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds for latency/error regressions
Coordinate with DevRel for blog and sample repo sync
Prepare rollback criteria and fallback model variant policy
Schedule launch announcement and coordinate communications (marketing + sales enablement)
Post-launch 72h war room schedule and on-call rotation

rollout_plan: Staged rollout over 4 windows: Canary (1% traffic, 24h), Early (5%, 24h), Ramp (25%, 24h), Full (100%). War-room active during Canary -> Early windows.
